TCU-GW-2 software release TCU_GW2_SW_4.12.0 (bench build)
------------------------------------------------------------
New
 * Remote charging control (CHARGING_START / CHARGING_STOP) over telematics.
 * HVAC pre-conditioning temperature set point now forwarded to BCM-4.
Known issues
 * KI-217: Body ECU heartbeat occasionally exceeds 100 ms on the bench (scheduler
           contention on the BCM-4 simulator). Cosmetic, no functional impact.
